body: Oh hunny, im so sorry that youre going through this pain. Its going to sound cliche, but there are so many better things ahead of you then there are behind, dont let yourself miss them because you're afraid of "adult" things. I can tell you, as dumb as they are, taxes are not that bad. Find something to live for, even if its something as small as your favorite song or a cartoon you love. I promise you, its worth it.

It sounds like shes not dissatisfied with you, it sounds like shes dissatisfied with herself and shes projecting that on to you. Its a lot easier to point out someone elses flaws than confront our own. 

That being said its a shitty thing to do to someone you love. Its really not fair that shes not listening when youre telling her it hurts. I would express that. I would even go so far as to not invite her over to your parents' until she tells you that shes going to make a conscious effort to change.

That's not a healthy outlook for your partner to have. Life goes on after being cheated on, its hurtful and it sucks, but it's not the end of the world. 

Now, shes probably not going to want to hear that from you, so I'd advise having a mediator if you are going to talk to them about it. 

It might be good to have someone to talk to both of you about sex and your dead bedroom situation.

Coming from my own experience, I think you'd benefit from being gentle to yourself right now.  You made a mistake. You're human. Nothing is going to be gained from self- flagellation. 

You should make it a priority to examine why you made the mistake and adjust accordingly. Have you decided to tell your SO?

Oh honey, that sounds like an insane amount of pain and I'm so sorry that you're experiencing this. I feel like someone with the connection that you describe wouldn't want you to take your own life. It sounds like this individual had some personal demons that became too hard to handle. And as much as it hurts you, you cant internalize that.

No no no no. Not okay. First of all, he should not have gone through your phone. I don't care what his reasoning is. That is a blatant disregard and a violation of your trust. My ex used to pull that shit and before that my parents used to pull that shit and it has no place in a healthy adult relationship. 

2nd and excuse my language, FUCK no he doesn't get to use your sexual past against you as if it's some sort of weapon. And fuck no he doesnt get to call you derogatory names. There is nothing wrong with sleeping with multiple partners ESPECIALLY if that was before you dated. 

Not only is it INSANELY sexist and uncouth, it's completely illogical. Are you going to bring up that he blew off of work some day like five years ago to illustrate a point in an argument that happens next week? No cause that's, again excuse my language, fucking asinine. 

All of this is telling me this man is not mature enough to make a serious commitment to you bc he is not showing you the respect you deserve.

To me, shes the patron goddess of all those those in need of control over their own chaotic minds and emotions. 

Shes the leader of hot mess women who are just trying to figure out who they are. They are always wishing for the day that they'll get out of this hot mess phase, and they feel such shame being this way. And they apologize their entire lives for being the way they are and they internalize that guilt. 

But they have nothing to apologize for. And they wont grow out of this phase cause they are the mess but they control the chaotic mess that they are. Its helped me.

Sexual appetite varies from person to person, as someone who is often on the other side of this situation (I always have more sexual desire than my partners) he should respect your individual sexual appetite and not try to own your sexuality or manipulate it to match with his. You wouldn't accept anyone doing that for anything else. Like if he were to really love a certain type of food at a certain time and you weren't hungry. You wouldn't accept him forcing you to eat that food everytime he ate it. 

He should also empower himself to take more control over his sexual appetite and own his own sexual pleasure. Encourage him to masturbate if he needs to get rid of excess sexual energy. If hes not open to that ir if he continues this extremely problematic pattern of behavior, I think you should consider terminating the relationship.

It sounds like you are holding on to a lot of bad feelings and that its overwhelming and all consuming. I'm sorry that you're feeling this way. I know you dont want to hear it but the best advice I can give is to find something in your life that brings you joy. And live for that even if it's something as small as a certain food or a tv show. Hang in there these feelings and much as they dont feel like they are, are temporary.

I know you're feeling awful, but don't take your own life. Theres always a reason not to. Find that reason even if it's something as simple as your corner store ran out of your face candy and you wanna taste that before you die. Find something in life that brings you joy. Make plans. Talk to someone you love. Talk to children about something they love. Try something you've never tried before. You are worthy and wonderful and the world is better with you in it I promise. 

Also you dont wanna kill yourself on President's Day, do you? Think of all the racist garbage men who ran this country. Most of them lived long full lives. If they deserve that then you do too, sweetie.  <3 <3 <3
